notes: No designer guide. Facts come from the package types; the summary, when present, is the component's own JSDoc; the example only shows the public API and is not design guidance.
summary: ListGroup component that mirrors the Figma "List Group" component.

examples.purpose: A labelled group of list rows.
examples.jsx:
<ListGroup label="Linked accounts" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>

</ListGroup>
